name: Steelgrill's Tools
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Beldin Steelgrill needs fresh tools to keep his workshop running. The master technician pushes siege engines and his own equipment hard, so shipments from nearby Kharanos keep arriving.

sections.title: A Heavy-Handed Craftsman
sections.body: Beldin Steelgrill is among Dun Morogh's finest siege engine technicians, but merchants know his rough touch. He works without pause on armored tanks and mechanical contraptions, and delicate tools break quickly in his hands. Arclight spanners snap and fang-ratchets wear out, so Beldin keeps ordering replacements from Kharanos to stock his repair benches.

sections.title: Keeping the Engines Rolling
sections.body: Beldin's tools help keep Ironforge's war machines in working order. At his depot northeast of Kharanos, he services combat vehicles for experienced drivers such as Pilot Stonegear. Fresh wrenches and ratchets keep the work moving on the siege engines assembled there, and the depot's repairs support local defenses.

faq.q: What are Steelgrill's Tools used for?
faq.answer: The tools replace worn mechanic implements at Steelgrill's Depot, where Beldin Steelgrill uses them to overhaul heavy dwarven machinery, including Pilot Stonegear's damaged siege engine.

faq.q: Why does Beldin Steelgrill go through so many tools?
faq.answer: Beldin works roughly and pushes his tools hard. Arclight spanners snap and fang-ratchets break so often that suppliers in Kharanos struggle to keep up.

faq.q: Where did this crate of tools come from?
faq.answer: The crate is assembled and filled in nearby Kharanos, then carried northeast to Steelgrill's Depot.
Beldin is a master dwarf mechanic who runs Steelgrill's Depot northeast of Kharanos. He is regarded as the region's finest siege engine technician.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can understand how repairs on heavy siege engines wear down arclight spanners and delicate wrenches.
As a dwarf, you know the pride of maintaining the Alliance's armored siege engines. Keeping Beldin supplied helps Ironforge's armored vanguard stay ready for combat.
